messages:
Devon: Quick flag - on the pctl board for /v1/complete I saw p50 briefly exceed p95 around the 11:06 canary ramp. Chart looked like a glitch.
Maya: Oof. Was that the new quota-fallback path enabled?
Devon: Yeah, we rolled a soft quota in eu-central that funnels some clients to fallback-host. Canary ramped 0->30->70% between 11:04-11:10.
Arun: Two likely culprits: (1) merging sketches from heterogeneous routes, (2) smoothing/downsampling order. If we smooth then merge we can create non-monotonic estimates.
Devon: The UI query is `percentile(50,95,99) over 1m step` and we apply a 3m exponential smoothing afterward.
console-team: Confirmed: current pipeline computes percentiles per-route, then merges t-digests, then applies smoothing on the series. That ordering is cheaper but fragile.
alerts-bot: alert: p50>p95 anomaly detected for /v1/complete (2025-11-11T11:07Z)
Maya: Also check sample counts. If fallback-route contributed only a handful of high-latency samples they can pull up merged p95 once weight crosses threshold.
Devon: Sample snapshot: total_count=900, merged_p95_count=12, fallback-route count=3 with latencies ~2.9s.
Arun: That's classic: low-count heavy tail + weighting change = sketch instability.
Maya: Short fixes: show per-route percentiles by default on rollouts, and add a provenance pill "merged from 2 routes (fallback:3 samples)".
console-team: UX proposal: (a) toggle to compute percentiles from merged raw buckets (expensive) when user clicks "exact recompute"; (b) add guard: if any contributor count < 20 then render merged percentile as "low-confidence" and show median+IQR instead.
Arun: For alerts: change rule to suppress merged-p95 alerts when merged_sample_count < 50 and instead send per-route p95 alerts.
Devon: I can reproduce locally by simulating a 2-route mix with counts [900,3] and raising the small-tail latency. Repro is cheap.
Maya: Long-term: store short-lived exact histograms for endpoints with frequent routing churn so we can do on-demand exact recompute without blowing CPU.
console-team: We'll open a small PR to add the low-confidence badge + tooltip text: "Merged percentile may be inaccurate when contributors have very low sample counts." Also adding a link to the oncall runbook.
Arun: I'll add a tdigest-diagnostic flag on the ingest path that logs contributor counts and centroids when a p95 delta > 25% occurs.
Devon: Action items: Devon -> attach repro and sample dump; console-team -> badge + tooltip PR; Arun -> diagnostic flag; Maya -> update alerting doc.
Maya: Thanks all. Leaving this pinned to the rollout channel until mitigations land. :thumbsup:
